title: Implants emitted radio signals during Japanese TV filming

tellings.quote: And but they started giving off they started giving off radio signals during a Japanese TV show I was I was uh filming.

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies, told podcast host Jesse Michels that some implants started giving off radio signals. He says this happened while he was filming for a Japanese TV show. If true, it would mean the implants are active devices that send out signals.
